item.title: Rethinking Production within Environmental Limits: Cleaner Pathways to Efficiency, Innovation and Circularity
item.content:encoded:
This special issue focuses on advancing cleaner production practices that operate within planetary boundaries. The collection seeks research on how industries can achieve greater efficiency while maintaining environmental responsibility, through innovations that support both operational improvements and circular economic principles. The special issue invites scholars and practitioners to explore integrated approaches to sustainable production systems.

Appel publié par Journal of Cleaner Production. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.
